name: Samaritan's Purse
summary: An evangelical Christian relief organisation based in Boone, North Carolina: emergency food, water, shelter and medical care in wars and disasters abroad (Sudan, South Sudan, the DRC, Gaza, Ukraine), US disaster relief and rebuilding, mission hospitals and field hospitals, Operation Christmas Child's shoebox gifts to children in over 100 countries, and Christian education and evangelism.

spending.source: https://app.fac.gov/dissemination/report/pdf/2025-12-GSAFAC-0000425886 (Samaritan's Purse consolidated financial statements, year to 31 December 2025, audited by Forvis Mazars, statement of activities p. 5: total ministry expenses $1,152,791,606 of total expenses $1,335,882,179)

lines.label: Emergency relief and recovery, Operation Christmas Child, medical ministry, children's projects, Christian education and other ministries
lines.source: https://app.fac.gov/dissemination/report/pdf/2025-12-GSAFAC-0000425886 (consolidated statement of activities, 2025, p. 5): emergency relief and recovery $480,206,414, medical ministry $71,588,399, Operation Christmas Child $490,070,259, children's ministry-other $7,778,859, Christian education $76,625,581, other ministry services $26,522,094. One line because charityevals models all six as branches of one humanitarian-relief model (relief abroad, clean water, US disaster relief, surgery, outpatient care, heart surgery, shoeboxes, material aid); the evangelism inside the faith lines keeps its cost in the model with no value on the site's scale.
